name: Lake Champlain - Port Henry, Bulwagga Bay, Crown Point

projection.toFrame: x = E + 6000, y = 7200 - N (origin NW corner, y down)
projection.frameNote: land ring segments lying on x=0, x=width, y=0 or y=height are the frame, not shoreline; skip them when stroking the coast

depthGrid.order: row-major from NW corner; cell (i,j) centre = (j*cell+cell/2, i*cell+cell/2)

clearance.note: Vertical Clearance 22.9m/75ft at Ordinary High Water (OHW) and 24.4m/80ft at Low Lake Level

datum.depths: feet below Low Lake Level (chart datum), which is 93.0 ft above mean sea level (US Coast Pilot 6, ch. 14)
datum.note: true water depth = chart depth + (lake stage ft NGVD29 - 93.0). Default 3 ft = long-term annual-mean stage (USGS 04294500 Lake Champlain at Burlington, param 62614: 96.1 ft 1940-2022, 96.5 ft 1991-2022) minus 93.0.

sources.name: NOAA ENC US4NY1LS ed.5 and US4NY1MS ed.3 (both issued 2026-04-20), compiled from chart 14784
sources.use: soundings, 0/6/12 ft contours (grid constraints), buoys, lights, bridge, obstructions, names, islet

sources.name: USGS National Hydrography Dataset High Resolution (Waterbody 7113802 Lake Champlain; NHDArea StreamRiver)
